Definition: Epher, the name of an Arabian and of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Epher — a calf — is the name of three men in Scripture: the second son of Midian, a son of Ezra among the descendants of Judah, and a head of a family of Manasseh east of the Jordan. The name is shared; the men are not, and each stands in his own genealogy.
TheologicalSignificance: God keeps the record, and no one in His story is only a name on a list. I believe even a name carried by three men matters, because each man stood in his own place in the genealogy that leads to David.
